nodes.label: RATIO: Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations
nodes.author: Maayan Sharon; Tom Hope
nodes.rationale: Standard topical-relevance retrieval benchmarks cannot distinguish ADDRESS/BROADEN/SPECIFY ideation moves, so the paper builds typed retrieval tasks from authors' own discourse markers.

nodes.label: Discourse-marker distant supervision extended to corpus-scale retrieval
nodes.rationale: Stripping the marker and forcing retrieval (not classification) of the gold sentence out of millions of candidates forces the model to encode the relation itself rather than surface lexical cues.

nodes.label: Rejected-marker distractor negative sampling
nodes.rationale: Random unrelated-sentence negatives were found in preliminary experiments to inflate results, so ~80% of negatives are near-miss sentences captured by markers considered and rejected during curation.
